title: FRED: MAMA'S HOUSE HARDER THAN WAR
topic: FRED: MAMA'S HOUSE HARDER THAN WAR
caption:
Fred recounts his two Purple Hearts and Bronze Stars, then delivers the killer line: "Ain't nothing harder than living with your mama." From
Blue in the Face, on Netflix
